BrochureContent.Content:
Brian Gleeson Property are delighted to bring to market this stunning five bedroom family home located in Ardmore, County Waterford.

This home offers the perfect opportunity to own a beautiful home within walking distance of the magical village of Ardmore. Whether you are seeking a full time home or a weekend retreat, this property will appeal to buyers who appreciate a prime location. This home represents an outstanding lifestyle choice.

The property features a porch, welcoming entrance hall, spacious living room with solid-fuel stove, and a bright kitchen, dining and living. The kitchen, which boasts a cast iron cooker, opens out to a raised deck, perfect for alfresco dining or enjoying your morning coffee while listening to the waves roll in to Ardmore Bay. Two generously proportioned bedrooms, private study and family bathroom complete the ground floor.

Upstairs there are three double bedrooms, a spacious living space/kitchenette along with a main family bathroom that completes the accommodation.
Set on circa 0.7 acres, the south facing rear garden provides excellent potential to create an outdoor space ideal for summer evenings and outdoor dining.
A large detached garage further enhances the property and provides the ideal area for a functioning workshop, storage, or for keeping your kayaks to enjoy the nearby Ardmore Blue Flag beach.

An added bonus to this property is the chalet on the grounds, with a precedence for its own private entrance, this unit has potential for a variety of different uses from a studio to an Air B&B (subject to the necessary planning permissions).

This home enjoys a prime position adjoining Ardmore GAA Club, offering the perfect setting for an active family, with sporting pursuits right on the doorstep. At the same time, the magical village is just a short walk away, ideal for enjoying a morning coffee, a leisurely stroll or an evening meal.
Ardmore is a picturesque seaside village set along the beautiful coastline of County Waterford. It offers a strong sense of community, national primary school, the renowned cliff walk, sandy beaches and breathtaking sea views. The village also boasts a vibrant cultural atmosphere with art galleries, craft shops and award winning restaurants, including the award wining Cliff House Hotel.

Beaches such as Ardmore, Curragh, Ballyquin, Goat Island and Whiting Bay are all within close proximity. The towns of Dungarvan and Youghal are approximately twenty minutes away, while Waterford and Cork city are both within easy reach for commuting.

This property offers a rare opportunity to secure a forever home in a highly desirable coastal location.

For further information or to arrange a private viewing, contact Brian Gleeson Property today.
